code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, respiratory acidosis (low pH, low O2, high CO2), anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, elevated ferritin and CRP, and mildly increased INR. Renal function is mildly impaired (creatinine high). No evidence of acute myocardial injury or COVID-19. Findings suggest acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory process, possible infection or systemic inflammation; clinical correlation and further investigation recommended.
